Settings

Mode & Rules

Zen always wraps around edges and has no obstacles or death — press ⏹ to end your run.

Daily Challenge always uses Medium grid, Normal difficulty, no wrap — same board all day.

Weekly Challenge always uses Medium grid, Normal difficulty, no wrap — same board all week.

Boss Challenge: hazards escalate fast, and every 3 levels a Boss with a health bar appears — eating apples damages it; defeat it for a +10 bonus.

Sandbox: no death, no obstacles ever spawn. Press 1-8 to spawn a specific apple type on demand.

Fill to Win: no rocks ever spawn on the map — grow your snake to fill every single cell of the board to win! Crashing into a wall or yourself still ends the run.

Speedrun: race to score 20 as fast as possible — the clock counts up.

Endless: hazards keep escalating forever with no obstacle cap — see how long you can survive.

Rush Hour: every lane has a nonstop moving obstacle, like crossing traffic. Time your gaps!

Randomizer: grid, difficulty, wrap and weather are re-rolled randomly every time you start a run.

Custom Scoring

Tweak how many points each apple type is worth. Leave alone for defaults.

                How to Play

                Use arrow keys or WASD to steer. Eat apples to grow — watch out for walls, obstacles, and your own tail.

                Special apples do different things: ⭐ bonus points, ⚡ speed frenzy, ❄ slow-mo, ✂ shrinks your tail, 🔨 destroys an obstacle, 🧲 magnet pulls food toward you, 🛡 shield absorbs your next crash.

                Hold Shift (or the ⚡ button on mobile) to boost — it costs a bit of length. Space pauses the game.

                Check ⚙️ Settings for game modes, difficulty, two-player, an AI opponent, graphics options, and more.

                Two-player extras: Q / (forward slash) whips your tail to stun the other snake if it's close behind you. Ctrl+1-4 (P1) or Alt+1-4 (P2) sends a taunt.

                Credits

                Snake — a single-file browser game with no external dependencies, no server, and no tracking. Everything runs locally in your browser; your progress lives only in this browser's storage.

                Audio

                Background music and sound effects were synthesized programmatically (chiptune-style waveforms) rather than recorded or licensed from anywhere.

                Art

                The title banner and scale texture were generated programmatically as well — no stock art or external images.

                Built with

                HTML5 Canvas, the Web Audio API, and vanilla JavaScript. No frameworks, no build step.
